arguments.code:
from pathlib import Path
import bpy,json
out=Path(r'D:\Dev\vibeGamingDemo1\ThreeHearthsVillage\Art\GoodsKit')
with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(out/'GoodsKit.blend'),link=False) as (src,dst):
    report={'source_blend':'GoodsKit.blend','objects':sorted(src.objects),'meshes':sorted(src.meshes),'materials':sorted(src.materials),'armatures':list(src.armatures),'actions':list(src.actions)}
assert len(report['objects'])==16 and len(report['meshes'])==8
assert not report['armatures'] and not report['actions']
assert all(name.startswith('goods_') for name in report['objects'])
assert all(name.startswith('GK_') for name in report['materials'])
report['original_goods_only']=True
report['licensed_character_geometry_in_source']=False
(out/'source-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('GOODS_SOURCE_AUDIT_PASSED')
